metadata.description: Starter scaffolding for Claude Code: process discipline, knowledge management, and delegation patterns that work for any kind of structured work — not just coding. Claude Code only (CLI + desktop app).

plugins.name: process-skills
plugins.description: Six domain-agnostic process skills: brainstorming (idea → validated design), planning-projects (staged plan with gates), executing-plans (drive a plan to done with evidence-of-done), evidence-first-investigation (figure out why before proposing what), review-document (holistic 30-second-rule review), peer-review-deliverable (review what's new against a baseline).

plugins.name: vault-librarian
plugins.description: Companion to the upstream obsidian-wiki plugin. One cross-platform slash command (/vault-librarian:bootstrap-vault) that sets up a Markdown notes vault from inside Claude Code, with persona-tuned schema templates for researchers, writers, and generalists. No shell snippets — works on Claude Code Desktop on macOS and Windows.

plugins.name: delegation-agents
plugins.description: Three model-pinned worker subagents (bulk-reader on Haiku, document-rewriter and draft-generator on Sonnet) plus a dispatching-parallel-agents skill. Lets a parent session on Opus offload bulk reading, editing, and drafting to cheaper, faster models. Domain-agnostic — works for research, writing, project management, analysis.
